name: ResendDigitalGiftCardMessage
description:
Resends the digital gift card `DigitalGiftCardMessage` (receiver) and/or `DigitalGiftCardSenderMessage`
(sender) message(s) for a single, already-shipped digital gift card line, regardless of the delivery mode of the gift card.

This service can be called with an `AccessToken` and `GiftCardID` combination. In this case, no
user validation is done - you know both keys to the GiftCard, so you are allowed to trigger a resend for it.

Employees and API users need the `ResendDigitalGiftCard` functionality, unless they are the customer of the order.

Requires the gift card line to already be shipped and its `DeliverySchedule` (if any) not to be in the future, as
the card has not been sent yet in that case. Fails when the requested target has no destination
configured on the line (no `ToEmailAddress`/`PhoneNumber` for `Receiver`, no `FromEmailAddress` for `Sender`).


Limited to 3 calls per card per hour.
auth_description: This service does not require authentication.

headers.name: EVA-IDs-Mode
headers.description: The IDs mode to run this request in. Currently only `ExternalIDs` is supported.

headers.name: EVA-IDs-BackendSystemID
